name: Magic Copy for Elementor
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Magic Copy for Elementor is the ultimate cross-site productivity tool designed for web designers, agencies, and developers. It allows you to copy any Elementor element (Widget, Column, Section, or Flex/Grid Container) directly from a live website’s frontend and paste it seamlessly into the Elementor editor on any other WordPress site.

Whether you’re building a multi-site component library, transferring client layouts, or saving reusable design blocks, Magic Copy eliminates tedious export/import file downloads and streamlines your design workflow.

🟢 FREE FEATURES (Included Out of the Box)

  • Frontend Live Copy: Hover over any enabled Elementor element on live frontend pages and click to copy immediately.
  • Cross-Domain Copy & Paste: Copy elements from Site A and paste them into Site B across completely different domain names.
  • Native Elementor Paste: Use standard keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+V on Mac / Ctrl+V on Windows) directly inside the Elementor editor.
  • Deep Copy & Style Retention: Captures all settings, layout parameters, custom typography, spacing, and CSS rules.
  • Child Elements Toggle: Choose whether to include nested child elements (columns, child containers, inner widgets) or copy only the parent wrapper.
  • Automatic Media Sideloading: Automatically handles image downloads and sideloads external media into the target site’s WordPress Media Library.
  • Access Control: Restrict the copy button visibility by user role (Administrators, Editors, Logged-in Users, or Everyone).
  • Toast Alerts & Loading States: Modern animated toast notifications and inline spinners for real-time copy and import feedback.
  • Flexbox & Grid Compatible: Fully optimized for modern Elementor Flexbox Containers, CSS Grid, and legacy Sections/Columns.

🟡 PROFESSIONAL PLAN FEATURES ($39 / yr)

Unlock powerful cloud library capabilities and workflow automation with Magic Copy Pro:

  • Personal Cloud Clipboard (Personal Cloud Library): Save copied elements to your cloud library hosted on manfii.com. Organize elements with titles and tags, and paste them into any site with 1-click inside the Elementor editor.
  • Shareable Template Links: Generate instant, shareable URL links for any copied element or section. Anyone with the link can auto-import it into their Elementor editor.
  • Copy History Snapshots: Rolling history panel inside Elementor storing your last 50 copied elements. Restore any past snapshot with a single click.
  • Global Copy Rules: Automatically enable Magic Copy on specific element types or CSS classes site-wide without manual widget toggles.
  • Granular Access Controls: Fine-grained role permission matrix and user ID whitelisting/blacklisting for agency client handoffs.

🔴 BUSINESS PLAN FEATURES ($99 / yr)

Designed for agencies, scaling teams, and multi-site networks:

  • Direct Cross-Site Push: Push containers, sections, and pages directly from Site A to target pages on Site B via secure REST API without touching the clipboard.
  • Team Cloud Clipboard (Shared Team Library): Shared cloud library workspace allowing entire agency teams and freelancers to build and reuse a centralized component library.
  • White-Label Branding: Rename the plugin, upload custom copy button icons, customize colors, and completely hide Magic Copy/Manfi branding from client sites.
  • WooCommerce Builder Support: Smart detection and mapping for WooCommerce product widgets, category lists, and shortcodes during cross-site import.
  • Unlimited Copy History: Remove the 50-snapshot limit and unlock searchable, categorized copy history archives.

How it Works:

  1. Enable “Magic Copy” in the Advanced tab of any Elementor widget, section, or container (or use Global Rules in Pro).
  2. Visit the live frontend page and hover over the element.
  3. Click the “Magic Copy” overlay button (or “Save to Cloud” with Pro).
  4. Open the Elementor editor on your destination site and press Cmd+V / Ctrl+V or click Import from Cloud Library.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/magic-copy-for-elementor, or install directly via WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Magic Copy > Settings to configure role permissions and options.
  4. Edit any page in Elementor to start copying elements.
sections.faq:
Does this work across completely different domains?

Yes! Magic Copy generates a standardized JSON payload that works seamlessly between different websites and domain names.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use this plugin?

No. Magic Copy works with free Elementor as well as Elementor Pro.

Can I save my copied elements to the cloud?

Yes! The Personal Cloud Library feature in Magic Copy Pro allows you to save elements to your personal cloud on manfii.com and access them inside Elementor on any site you manage.

How does media import work?

Magic Copy automatically downloads external images referenced in copied elements and sideloads them directly into your target site’s WordPress Media Library.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Feature: Added compatibility for Pro Personal Cloud Library integration.
  • Performance: Optimized Elementor editor asset loading routines and payload handlers.
  • Update: UX update and security patch.
  • Compatibility: Checked feature compatibility with latest Elementor.

1.0.9

  • Added: Freemius SDK integration for managing licensing and standalone Pro updates.
  • Added: Automatic database cleanup routine on plugin uninstall.
  • Updated: Unified deployment workflows for Free & Pro releases.

1.0.8

  • Update: Added modern pill-shaped copy overlay, inline loading spinners, and custom toast notification alerts.
  • Fix: Addressed PHPCS security sanitization warnings in AJAX controllers.
  • Compatibility: Updated WordPress compatibility tag to 7.0 and verified Elementor compatibility.

1.0.7

  • Fix: Security update.
  • Update: UX update.
  • Compatibility: Elementor compatibility check.
